_comment: Pattern: peace-protocol (blinded identity proof). Two secret scalars: a (the identity scalar, used for both pairing and as a G1 scalar) and r (the blinding factor). The public points v, w0, w1 are derived inside CircuitProve from (a, r) and the hardcoded G1 generator + G2 base point h0. v is supplied as a fixed compressed G1 hex; w0 and w1 are computed.
